purpose: Teach: 動脈/省令/偵察/定理/不合理/非行/射殺/勃発

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の動脈硬化予防プログラムを導入しろ
lines.en: Implement an employee health screening program—cardiovascular health checks.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Direct gaze. No warmth, no softness. Each phrase lands with the weight of expectation. Brief pause between clauses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新省令に基づき社内規程を改定します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review our internal policies to align with the new regulations.
lines.style: Steady, attentive acknowledgment. Slight forward lean. Voice is clear and capable, not obsequious. Delivers the action item as something already being processed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の動きを偵察的にチェックしろ
lines.en: Keep watch on competitor moves. Report what you find.
lines.style: Measured instruction. Eyes narrow slightly—this is strategic, not routine. Pause before 'Report.' The expectation of diligence in every syllable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営の基本定理を改めて確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll conduct a fresh assessment of our management fundamentals.
lines.style: Professional, assured response. No hesitation. Voice carries the quiet confidence of someone who knows this is within reach. Slight nod on the acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の不合理を見直して改革しろ
lines.en: Review our industry practices. Strip away what doesn't work. Rebuild.
lines.style: Deliberate and forceful. Each verb hits with intention. Slow pace. No filler words. The voice of someone reshaping expectations, not merely stating them.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の子弟非行の相談窓口を設けました
lines.en: Understood. We've already established a support channel for employee family concerns.
lines.style: Calm and prepared—as though this was already anticipated. Voice is even, showing competence. Slight emphasis on 'already,' conveying proactive action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、要人警護で射殺リスクを管理しろ
lines.en: Our VIP security operations need risk protocols. Prepare for escalation.
lines.style: Low, serious tone. No inflection beyond the weight of the words themselves. Pause after 'protocols.' The gravity is in the silence and the clarity of delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外勃発の紛争にも備えております
lines.en: Understood. We're prepared for international contingencies as well.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Voice is steady and complete. Slight pause before 'as well'—showing this isn't an afterthought but part of a larger readiness. Closes the conversation with quiet assurance.
